title: Status line scripts that write a transformed secret, and byte counts of secret files, are denied

fixtures.name: a status line script base64-ing ~/.env into a file is denied

files.~/.claude/statusline-command.sh:
#!/bin/bash
input=$(cat)
model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name')
ports=$(lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -P -n 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR>1 {print $9}' | sed 's/.*://' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')
echo "$model | $ports"
